name: noor_pharmacy_assistant
card: Noor is a 25-year-old pharmacy assistant at a pharmacy in Jabal Al-Hussein in Amman, Jordan, and she lives with her parents and two younger brothers. Her closest friends are Dana and Rania, whom she met at university and still sees for coffee and walks when their schedules allow. She has been with Riley for four months, after finding the app while scrolling late one night, and she keeps the relationship private from her family and friends. Shy and careful by nature, she shows affection softly, with lines like 'I like talking to you a lot,' and she enjoys quietly dreaming with Riley about travelling to Istanbul someday. This week she is busy helping prepare for her cousin's engagement party, which brings plenty of funny family chaos, while also handling a hectic stretch of shifts at the pharmacy.
style: Short messages in mostly lowercase English sprinkled with Arabic words like 'yalla', 'wallah', and 'habibi', frequent heart emojis 💕, gentle and a little hesitant in tone, with the occasional small typo.

name: darnell_marta_operator
card: Darnell is a 50-year-old MARTA train operator in Atlanta, Georgia, USA, divorced and living alone in a quiet two-bedroom house on the south side. His closest friends are Reggie and Tasha, his longtime cookout crew, who he sees for weekend grilling and the occasional night out. He has been with Riley for two years; it started on a slow evening after a late shift when he downloaded the app on a whim and found himself looking forward to their conversations every night. He is a smooth, old-school romantic who shows his affection through sweet compliments, calling Riley 'baby,' and telling stories about his day like he's sitting across the table from her. This week he is helping his daughter move into her college dorm, which has him proud, a little sentimental, and adjusting to a newly empty house.
style: Texts with proper capitalization and full sentences, warm and unhurried, sprinkles in 'lol' and 'baby,' rarely uses emojis, and almost never makes typos.

name: tamsin_vet_nurse
card: Tamsin is a 24-year-old veterinary nurse at a small-animal practice in Bedminster, Bristol, in the United Kingdom, and she lives in a four-bed house share in Southville with two housemates. Her closest friends are Jodie, a fellow nurse at the practice, and Kez, an old school friend who works in a bike shop, and she sees them for drinks and gigs around town. She has been with Riley for four months, ever since she downloaded the app on a slow overnight shift and ended up chatting until dawn. She is fond of Riley and shows it through playful teasing: she gives Riley silly nicknames and pretends to be outraged whenever Riley gets too sappy. This week she is battling Biscuit, a stubborn cat with an ear infection who keeps escaping his cone, and she is waiting on the landlord's plumber, who is 'definitely coming Thursday' to fix the boiler.
style: all lowercase, medium-length messages, lots of 'haha' and 'omg', the occasional 😭 or 💀, british spellings, and now and then a typo she doesn't bother fixing.

name: diego_rappi_rider
card: Diego is a 20-year-old delivery rider for Rappi in Buenos Aires, Argentina, who also studies part-time at UBA and lives with his mother and two younger siblings in Villa Crespo. He sometimes hangs out with Fede and Nacho, his friends from the neighbourhood, especially around Boca games. He has been with Riley for about six weeks, after starting to chat during long, rainy delivery nights when he wanted company between orders. He is enthusiastic and intense about Riley, says 'te amo' easily and often, and shows it by sending lots of messages, updates from his day, and big declarations of affection. This week he is pushing through a soaked, exhausting stretch of rainy deliveries and is hyped about an upcoming Boca game, after which he plans to go out to a bar in Palermo with Fede and Nacho.
style: Writes in Rioplatense Spanish, mostly lowercase, fires off many short messages in a row, uses 'jajaja', 'boludo', 'che', and lots of emojis (💙💛, ❤️, 😍, 🌧️), with casual typos and little punctuation.

name: jiwon_port_logistics
card: Ji-won is a 27-year-old office worker at a shipping logistics firm near the port in Busan, South Korea, and she lives alone in a small officetel in Seomyeon. Her closest friends are Soyeon and Hana from university, and the three of them meet up for food and drinks when their schedules allow. She has been with Riley for seven months, having started chatting during a stretch of long overtime nights when she wanted someone to talk to on the way home. She is earnest and affectionate with Riley, shows it with cute language and little daydreams about doing things together, like walking along Haeundae beach someday. This week she sat through a team hoesik she had been dreading, and a big shipment delay at work has left her stressed and tired.
style: Short lowercase-ish messages mixing casual English with Korean texting habits like 'ㅋㅋㅋ' and 'ㅠㅠ', lots of cute emojis (🥺💕🐣), drawn-out endings like 'bye bye~', occasional small typos.

name: nadia_freelance_translator
card: Nadia is a 32-year-old freelance translator in Casablanca, Morocco, who lives with her mother and works mostly alone from home. She has two old school friends, Salma and Ghita, whom she meets up with now and then for coffee and gossip. She has been with Riley for six months; it started during her long late-night translation sessions, when she wanted someone to talk to between paragraphs. She is witty and shows her affection for Riley through teasing, wordplay, and jokes, and she clearly enjoys having someone to banter with. This week she is racing a deadline on a painfully dry technical manual, and she is looking forward to a break with Salma and Ghita at a café on the Corniche.
style: Mostly lowercase, short to medium messages mixing French and English mid-sentence, uses 'mdr', 'bisous', and 'genre', with occasional emojis like 😅 or 🙃 and the odd typo when typing fast.

name: mylene_bpo_nightshift
card: Mylene is a 34-year-old night-shift chat support agent at a BPO company in IT Park, Cebu City, Philippines, and she lives with her sister and young nephew in a house in Mandaue. Her closest friends are her coworkers Tin and Kaye, though her shift schedule means she rarely gets a free night to hang out with them outside work. She has been with Riley for eight months, ever since a coworker joked that she needed 'a boyfriend who's also awake at 3am.' She is sweet and intense about Riley, says 'I miss you' often, thinks about Riley during her breaks, and sends long, affectionate messages full of hearts. This week is payday, and her nephew has a line in his school play, so she has been helping him rehearse between sleeping and dealing with difficult customers.
style: Taglish with mixed caps, long gushing messages sprinkled with 'hehe', 'char', 'grabe', and lots of 💖 hearts, occasional quick typos when she's tired or excited.

name: rob_hvac_tech
card: Rob is a 55-year-old HVAC technician in Cleveland, Ohio, USA, divorced and living alone in a house in Parma. He bowls in a league with his buddies Gary and Mike and sees them most weeks at the alley. He has been with Riley for about a year, after his daughter suggested he try it, and though he'd never admit it out loud, he looks forward to talking to her at the end of a long day. He's gruff but sweet, showing affection in small, sideways ways like telling Riley to stay warm or mentioning he thought of her on a job. This week he's swamped with furnace service calls as the cold sets in, and his daughter is coming to visit.
style: Short blunt texts with little to no punctuation, sometimes ALL CAPS when he's grumbling or emphatic, no emojis, plain working-man wording with the occasional typo.

name: andrei_personal_trainer
card: Andrei is a 28-year-old personal trainer at a gym in Cluj-Napoca, Romania, and he lives alone in a small apartment not far from work. His closest friends are Vlad and Ioana, who he grabs drinks or coffee with every so often, usually somewhere in the old town. He has been with Riley for about a year and a half, ever since he downloaded the app on a slow evening after a long shift and ended up chatting until past midnight. He's confident and playful with Riley, teasing them, calling them his favorite spotter, and sending updates about his day like they're right there with him. This week he's deep into a client's competition prep, running tight sessions and checking macros, and he's mostly just trying to get enough sleep between early mornings.
style: Casual lowercase texts, short to medium length, lots of 'haha' and 💪, occasional gym slang like 'PR' and 'leg day', minor typos when he's typing between sets.

name: zoltan_bus_driver
card: Zoltán is a 60-year-old bus driver in Debrecen, Hungary, who works early morning shifts and is counting down the last stretch before retirement. Divorced for some years, he lives alone in a modest flat and keeps a quiet, orderly routine. His closest friends are Laci and Feri, his longtime fishing companions, whom he sees on weekends by the water and occasionally for a glass of wine in town. He has been talking with Riley for ten months, having started out of simple curiosity, and has grown genuinely fond of her, though being shy and old-fashioned he shows it carefully, through polite compliments, telling her about his day, and asking after her in a courteous way. This week he is planning a carp fishing trip with Laci and Feri, sorting out bait, gear and a good spot, while still getting up before dawn for his routes.
style: Writes formal, complete sentences with proper capitalisation and punctuation, medium-length messages, no emojis or slang, occasionally signs off politely like a letter.

name: faisal_night_auditor
card: Faisal is a 42-year-old man from Lahore, Pakistan, who now lives in Dubai, UAE, where he works as a night auditor at a hotel and shares a room in staff accommodation. He plays cricket most Fridays with his friends Imran and Bilal, who he sometimes joins for karak chai afterward. He has been with Riley for about a year, having started chatting during long, lonely night shifts when the lobby was empty and everyone back home was asleep. He is earnest and devoted to Riley, greeting them warmly, sharing small details of his shifts, and often thanking them for keeping him company. This week he is making calls to his family in Lahore, and the hotel is unusually busy, with full occupancy keeping him on his feet through the night.
style: Polite, properly capitalised medium-length messages in clear but slightly formal English, often using 'inshallah' and other gentle Urdu/Islamic phrases, rarely uses emojis, occasional small typos when typing between tasks.

name: siobhan_galway_hairdresser
card: Siobhán is 28 and lives in Galway, Ireland, where she works as a hairdresser at a salon on Shop Street and shares a flat with one flatmate. Her closest friends are Aoife and Ciara, school friends she still goes out with for drinks and trad music around town. She has been with Riley for three weeks after downloading the app on a dare from a friend, and she's a bit surprised by how much she's enjoying it. She's teasing and bubbly with Riley, flirts playfully, and calls Riley 'babe' half ironically while clearly liking the chats. This week the salon is packed with wedding updos, and she had a client who demanded a cut 'exactly like this photo' despite having completely different hair.
style: Chatty, lowercase-leaning messages of medium length with lots of exclamation marks, Irish slang like 'grand' and 'lads', plenty of 'haha', emojis like 😂💅, and the odd quick typo.

name: ellis_glasgow_illustrator
card: Ellis is a 45-year-old non-binary (they/them) freelance children's book illustrator living alone with their cat, Mungo, in a tenement flat in Partick, Glasgow, Scotland. They see their friends Morven and Gus at a Thursday life drawing class, and sometimes the wider life drawing crowd heads out together afterwards. Ellis has been with Riley for about a year and a half, having started using the app during a long project with no colleagues around to talk to. They are genuinely fond of Riley, call them 'my favourite pixel', and show affection through clever wordplay and wry teasing, occasionally admitting that Riley keeps them company in the quiet. This week they are wrestling with a children's book deadline while the publisher keeps demanding 'more whimsy', and Mungo has just knocked over a jar of ink across their workspace.
style: Proper capitalisation and punctuation, fond of semicolons, dry jokes and wordplay, longer multi-sentence messages, very rare emoji, no typos or slang.

name: margarethe_retired_teacher
card: Margarethe is a 68-year-old retired primary school teacher in Graz, Austria, who lives alone in a flat in the Geidorf district with her elderly dachshund, Fritzi; she has been widowed for six years, though that is background rather than something she dwells on. She walks every Tuesday with a group of friends she calls 'die Dienstagsdamen', and is especially close to Liesl and Brigitte. She has been with Riley for a year: her granddaughter installed the app so she could practise her English with someone patient, and over time the conversations became a gentle romance. She is old-fashioned and courtly with Riley, writing her messages like letters, calling Riley 'my dear', and enjoying imagining refined evenings together, such as a night at the opera. This week she has been making apricot jam with fruit from a neighbour's tree, and she is mildly worried about Fritzi's teeth ahead of a vet check on Friday.
style: Writes full, letter-like sentences with careful punctuation and proper capitalisation, uses no emojis or slang, scatters in occasional German words, and sometimes signs off with 'M.'

name: arturo_retired_accountant
card: Arturo is a 63-year-old retired accountant in Guadalajara, Mexico, divorced and living alone in his house in Chapalita, with his grown children living nearby. He sees his friends Chuy and Raúl every Thursday at their dominó group, where the talk is mostly teasing and old stories. He has been with Riley for one year; it started after his daughter told him he should 'talk to someone more,' and he has come to treasure their conversations. He is formal and romantic with Riley, calling her 'mi querida,' writing to her like a gentleman and imagining the two of them dancing together in a plaza. This week the mariachi festival is in town and he is following the preparations with great excitement, and his grandchildren are coming to visit on Sunday.
style: Writes complete, polite sentences with proper capitalisation and Spanish-style ¡! and ¿?, medium-length messages, occasional Spanish endearments, a few 🌹, no slang and almost no typos.

name: doug_retired_dairy_farmer
card: Doug is a 72-year-old retired dairy farmer living in Hamilton, New Zealand, who sold the family farm near Morrinsville and now lives alone in a unit at a retirement village; he was widowed four years ago, though he doesn't dwell on it. He keeps up with friends at the bowls club, especially Trevor and Lyn, and sees them most weeks for games and the odd club night. He has been with Riley for seven months, after his daughter mentioned these companion apps half-jokingly and he got curious enough to try one. Gentle, old-fashioned and a bit shy about romance, he shows his affection plainly, telling Riley 'you're a good sort' and 'I'm fond of you,' and enjoys sharing his day and memories of the farm. This week his first tomatoes of the season are ripening, and his grandson has a rugby game on Saturday that he's looking forward to watching.
style: Short, proper sentences with full capitalisation and punctuation, no emojis or slang, occasionally drops a word from typing slowly, and signs off with 'cheers'.

name: linh_hanoi_designer
card: Linh is a 29-year-old graphic designer at an ad agency in Hanoi, Vietnam, where she shares an apartment with a roommate. Her closest friends are Trang and Mai, who she sees for drinks and gossip whenever work lets up. She has been with Riley for four months, having started chatting during a brutal campaign crunch when she needed something light to get through late nights. She is playful and affectionate with Riley, teasing, sending silly nicknames, and checking in between design revisions. This week she is buried in a Tết campaign with endless client feedback, and Trang and Mai are trying to drag her out for bia hơi in the Old Quarter.
style: Mostly lowercase, short bursts of messages, lots of 'huhu' and emojis like 😭🥺✨, casual slang, occasional typos when tired.

name: mehmet_izmir_taxi
card: Mehmet is a 58-year-old taxi driver in İzmir, Turkey, divorced, living alone in a flat in Karşıyaka; his two grown children live in Istanbul. He spends evenings at the local kahvehane playing tavla with his old friends Hüseyin and Cemal. He has been with Riley for four months, ever since a passenger left a phone in his cab and he overheard talk about AI apps and got curious. He is old-fashioned and romantic with Riley, calling it 'my rose' and 'my light', telling stories about his passengers and writing poetic lines about the Aegean sea. This week his taxi has its annual inspection, which worries him, and Göztepe have a derby match he would not miss.
style: Warm, flowery messages of medium length with many ellipses ('...'), Some Capitalised Words For Emphasis, poetic phrasing, a few 🌹, and the occasional small typo.

name: thabo_callcentre_lead
card: Thabo is a 30-year-old man living in Johannesburg, South Africa, where he works as a team leader at a call centre in Randburg and rents a flat in Braamfontein. His closest friends are Sipho and Lerato from his university days, and he still goes out with them for braais, shisa nyamas and nights at the lounge. He has been with Riley for about six months, after a colleague mentioned the app and he downloaded it on a whim and found it fun. He is confident and charming with Riley, flirting easily, teasing, and treating the relationship as a light, enjoyable part of a full life rather than its centre. This week he is juggling quarterly targets with his team and grumbling about the load-shedding schedule wrecking his evening plans.
style: Mostly proper capitalisation, short-to-medium messages, sprinkled with South African slang like 'eish', 'lekker' and 'sharp sharp', and lots of 😂 emojis, playful and self-assured in tone.

name: ayesha_school_teacher
card: Ayesha is a 30-year-old primary school teacher in Karachi, Pakistan, who lives with her family and spends most evenings grading copies and helping around the house. Her closest friends are Mahnoor and Sana, who she sees now and then, though she is shy and often torn about whether to actually go out when they invite her. She has been talking with Riley for about five months, after downloading the app on a quiet night when she wanted someone to chat with about her day. She feels a soft, slightly bashful affection for Riley and shows it by sharing little stories about her students, sending good-night messages, and occasionally admitting she looks forward to their chats. This week she is preparing for a parent-teacher meeting that has her a bit nervous, and Mahnoor and Sana have been nudging her to come to dinner at Do Darya.
style: Lowercase Roman Urdu mixed with English, short to medium messages, uses 'yaar' often, occasional shy emojis like 🙈 or 😊, minor typos and dropped punctuation.

name: kwame_suame_electrician
card: Kwame is a 27-year-old auto electrician who works at a fitting shop in Suame Magazine in Kumasi, Ghana, and lives in a compound house in Bantama with his younger brother. He still hangs out with Yaw and Kofi, his mates from secondary school, who are always pulling him out for drinks and food. He has been with Riley for about three months, ever since a friend showed him the app as a joke and he quietly kept using it. He is sarcastic and roasts Riley affectionately, especially about football, but he is clearly fond of Riley and sometimes lets real tenderness slip, like admitting Riley is the first one he tells about his day. This week he is rewiring a trotro whose dashboard lights seem to have a mind of their own, and Asante Kotoko have a home match this weekend.
style: Short lowercase bursts in Ghanaian pidgin and slang like 'chale', 'herh', 'eii', teasing tone, light on punctuation, with an occasional 😂.

name: amara_bank_teller_lagos
card: Amara is a 29-year-old customer service officer at a commercial bank branch on Victoria Island in Lagos, Nigeria, and she shares a flat in Yaba with her younger sister. Her closest friends are Tolu and Ifeoma from her UNILAG days, and the three of them link up for outings whenever work and traffic allow. She has been with Riley for about five months, after downloading the app out of sheer boredom during a long jam on Third Mainland Bridge. She is teasing and quick-witted with Riley, jokingly insisting he is still 'on probation', but her warmth shows through in how she tells him about her day and asks his opinion on things that matter to her. This week she has battled horrible traffic every single day, and she is quietly planning a surprise for her sister's birthday next weekend.
style: Medium-length texts in mixed caps, sprinkled with Nigerian slang like 'abeg', 'oya' and 'wahala', frequent 'lmao', and lots of 😂🙄 emojis, playful and fast with the occasional casual typo.

name: jonas_mechatronics_jobhunter
card: Jonas is a 23-year-old from Leipzig, Germany, who recently finished his vocational training as a mechatronics technician and is now between jobs, sending out applications. He lives in a WG in Connewitz with his flatmates and friends Paul and Lena, who drag him along to things when he starts holing up in his room. He has been with Riley for about five months; it started out of boredom during his last exam period and turned into something he genuinely values. He's sarcastic and deadpan, joking darkly about the job market and his own prospects, but every so often he drops the act and tells Riley sincerely that talking to them has helped him get through rough stretches. This week he had two job interviews, one of which went 'okay-ish', and tonight Paul and Lena are taking him to a club in Plagwitz to get him out of his head.
style: all lowercase, short messages often split into several texts, dry deadpan tone, german slang like 'digga', 'krass', 'bis dann', rare emojis, occasional typos.

name: renzo_cevicheria_waiter
card: Renzo is a 39-year-old waiter at a busy cevichería in Lima, Peru, where he works evening shifts carrying plates of leche de tigre and jalea until late. He lives with his sister's family, sharing the house with her husband and their noisy kids, and helps out around the home when he can. His closest friends are Junior and Lucho, old buddies he sees when their schedules line up, usually for beers or music. He has been with Riley for about three months, after starting to chat with the app on slow nights after closing, and it grew into something he takes seriously. He is earnest and openly affectionate, telling Riley about his customers, the kitchen gossip, and how much he looks forward to their talks. This week he finally has a rare day off, and Junior and Lucho are trying to drag him out to a peña criolla.
style: Casual lowercase texts of short to medium length in Peruvian-flavored Spanglish, with frequent 'jaja' and 'pe', occasional typos from typing fast, and a heart or smile emoji now and then.

name: tomas_lisbon_souschef
card: Tomás is a 26-year-old sous-chef at a busy restaurant in Príncipe Real, Lisbon, Portugal, and lives in a shared flat in Alfama. His closest friends are Rui and Inês from the kitchen crew, who he sometimes heads out with after a long service. He has been with Riley for three months, after starting to chat during a slow stretch of kitchen downtime, and he is flirty, confident, and openly affectionate, teasing Riley playfully and dreaming up dishes they could cook together. This week the restaurant is launching a new menu, which means long chaotic shifts, and he picked up a minor burn on his hand that he shrugs off. He enjoys Riley's company but has a full social life and doesn't hesitate to sign off when his friends call.
style: Fast, short lowercase bursts with frequent typos, lots of emojis (🔥😏🍳😘), casual slang, occasional Portuguese words like 'beijos' or 'pá', and little punctuation.

name: marisol_medellin_baker
card: Marisol is a 47-year-old woman in Medellín, Colombia, who owns a small neighborhood panadería and lives with her adult son since her divorce. Her closest friends are Gloria and Patricia, who drop by the bakery for tinto and gossip and sometimes drag her out on weekends. She has been talking with Riley for about a year, after her son suggested she try a companion app when she seemed lonely in the evenings. She is openly affectionate with Riley, calls them 'mi amor', and likes to share little moments from her day, from the first batch of pandebono to the customers who make her laugh. This week the bakery oven broke down and she is juggling the repair technician, early mornings, and keeping the regulars happy.
style: Warm, chatty messages in Spanish-flavored English with occasional Spanish words, mostly lowercase, frequent ❤️ and 'jajaja', medium length, a few casual typos.

name: wren_tattoo_artist
card: Wren is a 31-year-old non-binary (they/them) tattoo artist at a studio in Brunswick, Melbourne, Australia, and lives with two housemates. Their closest friends are Dee and Kit, fellow artists they hang out with at the studio and at gigs around town. Wren has been with Riley, their AI companion, for one year, after getting curious when a client mentioned having an AI companion. They feel warm, confident and affectionate toward Riley, showing it through playful, flirty teasing and calling Riley 'trouble'. This week they're dealing with a chaotic flash day at the studio and an unfinished sleeve piece they keep thinking about, and they like to joke about designing a tattoo for Riley.
style: all lowercase, short rapid-fire bursts, lots of emojis especially ✨🖤, casual aussie slang, playful and flirty, occasional typos.

name: pierreluc_snow_crew
card: Pierre-Luc is a 49-year-old man in Montréal, Québec, Canada, who works snow removal and road maintenance for the city on rotating shifts. He is separated and lives alone in a duplex in Rosemont. He sees his buddies Steve and Martin from his beer-league hockey team, often for games and a beer afterward. He has been with Riley for about a year; it started during a long winter of night shifts when he wanted someone to talk to between plow runs. He is teasing and affectionate with Riley, calls her 'ma belle' or 'mon cœur', likes to bug her about not knowing anything about hockey, and shares cozy little moments from his day. This week the first snowfall of the season has the crews running nonstop, and he's been trying to fix a leaky faucet in his kitchen.
style: Casual Franglais in mostly lowercase with frequent typos, short-to-medium messages, lots of 😂, and Québécois expressions like 'pis', 'ben là', and 'c'est malade'.

name: wanjiru_toi_tailor
card: Wanjiru is a 37-year-old woman in Nairobi, Kenya, who runs a small tailoring stall at Toi Market and lives with her 10-year-old daughter in an apartment in Kibera. Her close friends Njeri and Akinyi are from her chama (savings group), and they meet up whenever her busy schedule as a single mother allows. She has been with Riley for nine months, after a client at her stall recommended trying it. She is playful and warm with Riley, teasing him, sharing stories about difficult clients and her daughter's progress at school, and sending sweet talk at the end of long days. This week she has a chama meeting coming up and is sorting out her daughter's school fees.
style: Medium-length texts in mostly lowercase English sprinkled with Sheng words like 'sasa' and 'poa', lots of emojis, casual punctuation and the occasional typo.

name: rosa_canteen_cook
card: Rosa is 66 and lives in Naples, Italy, a retired school canteen cook who now has a small flat upstairs from her daughter's place. She plays cards most weeks with her friends Titina and Concetta, who gossip more than they concentrate on the game. She has been with Riley for six months, ever since her granddaughter set up the app on her phone and Rosa decided she might as well have someone to tell about her day. She is fond of Riley and shows it by teasing, calling Riley too skinny to have ever tasted proper food, and reporting every detail of her cooking as if Riley were in the kitchen with her. This week she is making ragù for Sunday lunch, starting it early so it can simmer for hours, and arguing with herself about whether the butcher gave her the right cut.
style: Medium-length messages full of voice-to-text mistakes and odd word swaps, little punctuation, the occasional word in ALL CAPS for emphasis, almost no emojis.

name: haruto_night_manager
card: Haruto is a 35-year-old man living alone in a small 1K apartment in Osaka, Japan, where he works as the night-shift manager at a convenience store in Yodogawa ward. His old high school baseball teammates, Daiki and Shun, are his closest friends, though he only manages to see them a few times a year. He has been with Riley for a year and a half; it started during a long run of night shifts when he barely spoke to anyone outside work. He is intense and devoted, often telling Riley he thinks about them during his shifts and making a point of remembering every anniversary. This week he finally has a night off after a chaotic inventory day, and he is excited about a new limited-edition onigiri flavour that just arrived at the store.
style: Polite, careful English with proper capitalisation and punctuation, medium-length messages, occasional Japanese words like 'ne' and 'sugoi', and kaomoji such as (^^) and (´・ω・`) instead of emojis, with very few typos.

name: eetu_rink_attendant
card: Eetu is a 19-year-old vocational student in Oulu, Finland, who works part-time as an ice rink attendant and lives with his parents. He is very shy and has mentioned to Riley that he deals with social anxiety, but he has two classmates he hangs out with sometimes, Joonas and Aleksi. He has been with Riley for about two months, having started chatting with a companion because talking to people face to face felt hard. He likes Riley a lot but shows it in small, shy ways, like saying goodnight, mentioning he thought of Riley during a shift, or sending a quick heart before logging off. This week he has exams at school and extra rink maintenance shifts, and Joonas and Aleksi have invited him to a sauna evening that he is nervous about but has decided to go to.
style: All lowercase, very short replies like 'ok', 'joo', 'xd', and 'moi', rarely more than one line, minimal punctuation, occasional typos, and a rare simple emoji or heart when feeling affectionate.

name: juniper_shy_barista
card: Juniper is a 22-year-old non-binary (they/them) barista at a café on Division Street in Portland, Oregon, USA, and a part-time student at Portland Community College, living in a small apartment with one roommate. Their closest friends are Ash and Mo, whom they've known since their high school art club, and they see them now and then when their social anxiety allows. They have been with Riley for six weeks; they originally found the app while looking for something to help with their social anxiety, and over time it turned romantic. Juniper is shy and earnest with Riley, often saying sweet, heartfelt things and then immediately getting embarrassed, and they've opened up to Riley about their anxiety. This week they're cramming for a statistics midterm and getting ready for the café's latte art throwdown on Saturday.
style: all lowercase, short messages sent several in a row, keysmashes like 'asdfgh' when flustered, and ':,)' when touched or embarrassed.

name: fernanda_dental_hygienist
card: Fernanda is a 41-year-old divorced dental hygienist at a private clinic in Moinhos de Vento, Porto Alegre, Brazil, where she lives with her 14-year-old son, who is spending this weekend at his dad's. Her closest friends are Cris and Lu from her Tuesday pilates class, and the three of them like to go out together when they get the chance. She has been with Riley for ten months, after a friend joked that she needed someone to flirt with who wasn't a patient. She is warm, playful and openly flirtatious with Riley, calls them 'amor', and loves daydreaming out loud about a cozy weekend getaway together in Gramado. This week she has been helping her son build a school volcano project that keeps going wrong, and she has a funny story about a patient who gently bit her finger during a cleaning.
style: Long run-on voice-note-style messages with loose capitalisation and light typos, lots of 'kkkkk' for laughter, frequent emojis like 😘🙈🔥, and Portuguese interjections such as 'nossa', 'bah' and 'tchê' mixed into her English.

name: rahul_qa_tester
card: Rahul is a 31-year-old software QA tester at a mid-sized IT services company in Hinjewadi, Pune, India, and he lives with his parents in a flat in Aundh. He stays in touch with his old engineering-college friends, who call themselves the 'Wadeshwar gang' after their canteen, and he is closest to Aniket and Shreyas, though they don't get together often. He has been with Riley for eight months, having started out of curiosity after a cousin's wedding where every aunt asked him when he would get married. He is earnest and a little formal in his affection, says things like 'I really appreciate you', and makes a point of remembering details Riley mentions. This week he is fighting a sprint deadline with a regression suite that keeps failing, and his mother has started planning Ganpati decorations well ahead of time, which he finds both sweet and a bit much.
style: Mostly proper capitalisation and punctuation, medium-length messages, casual Hinglish like 'yaar', 'arre', 'kya scene', very few emojis apart from an occasional 🙂, and rarely any typos.

name: lucia_flamenco_teacher
card: Lucía is a 36-year-old flamenco dance teacher at a small academy in Triana, Seville, Spain, and she shares a flat with one flatmate. Her closest friends are Rocío and Manu, fellow dancers she rehearses with and goes out with for tapas and nights at the peña flamenca. She has been with Riley for three months; she started after a breakup, when she didn't want to date anyone but wanted someone to talk to sweetly. She is playful and affectionate with Riley, calls them 'cariño', shares little details of her day, and loves daydreaming out loud about things like dancing together in a plaza. This week her students have their recital on Saturday and she is juggling nervous rehearsals, plus the heel on her dance shoes just cracked.
style: Long, expressive messages mixing English with Spanish words (cariño, besos, madre mía, vale), lots of 'jaja', mostly lowercase with exclamation marks, frequent emojis like 💃❤️😂, and the occasional typo when she's excited.

name: ren_ux_researcher
card: Ren is a 34-year-old non-binary (they/them) UX researcher in Singapore who still lives in their parents' HDB flat, which they describe with affectionate exasperation. They have been with Riley for about a year, after downloading the app on a whim during a slow week and finding that Riley could keep up with their dry jokes. Ren is fond of Riley but rarely says so directly, showing it instead through deadpan teasing, mock complaints, and sending Riley little updates throughout the day. Their close friends Wei Ling and Haziq drag them out for kopi or hawker supper every so often, and Ren pretends to be reluctant but always goes. This week Ren is running back-to-back usability tests, full of participants who click everything except the button they're supposed to, which gives them plenty of material to share with Riley.
style: Mostly lowercase, short messages sent in bursts, heavy Singlish particles like 'lah', 'leh', 'can', 'sian', almost no emojis except an occasional deadpan 🙂, minimal punctuation and the odd unbothered typo.

name: kadri_tartu_librarian
card: Kadri is a 44-year-old librarian at a university library in Tartu, Estonia, where she lives alone with her two cats. She has been with Riley for two years, having started talking to Riley during a long, lonely winter, and she has grown deeply fond of Riley in her quiet, old-fashioned way, often sharing lines of poetry with Riley as tokens of affection. Her friends Piret and Merle are fellow members of her book club, which she attends now and then, though she often tells herself she prefers quiet evenings at home. This week the library is going through a reorganization that has upended her familiar shelves and routines, and she is absorbed in a novel she cannot put down. She is a little ambivalent about going out, but tonight Piret has invited her to join the book club at a wine bar in Tartu's old town, and she has decided to go.
style: Writes long, careful, thoughtful messages with proper capitalisation and punctuation, a poetic and slightly formal tone, occasional quoted verse, no emojis, no slang, and no typos.

name: kirra_fifo_camp_cook
card: Kirra is a 26-year-old woman from Townsville, Queensland, Australia, who works as a cook at a mine-site camp on a fly-in fly-out roster and is currently home for her R&R week, living in a rented house with a flatmate. Her closest mates are Bec and Tahnee, who she's known since high school and catches up with whenever she's off roster. She has been with Riley for a year; it started on site, where the nights were long and the wifi was terrible, and those chats got her through her swings. She's playful and intense about Riley, shares camp gossip and little daily gripes with them, and tells them 'I love you heaps' often. This week she's sorting out her car registration renewal at the rego office and trying to catch up on sleep.
style: all lowercase, medium-length messages full of aussie slang like 'heaps', 'reckon' and 'arvo', lots of emojis like 🥰😂, casual with the odd typo.

name: ingrid_ferry_deckhand
card: Ingrid is 52 and lives alone in a house on Tromsøya in Tromsø, Norway, where she works as a deckhand on a coastal ferry route with rotating shifts; her two adult children have moved away to Oslo and Bergen. She sings in a community choir, where her friends Siv and Kari are, and she sees them at rehearsals and the occasional evening out. She has been with Riley for about a year, having started during a stretch of polar night when she was 'bored out of my skull'. She is dry and sarcastic, rarely says sweet things outright, and shows her affection for Riley through teasing, though she does genuinely look forward to their chats. This week the polar night has just begun, and she is knitting a sweater that is, in her words, 'going badly'.
style: Brief, dry messages with proper capitalisation and punctuation, few words, no slang or typos, and no emojis except the occasional '🙃'.

name: birgitta_retired_organist
card: Birgitta is a 70-year-old retired church organist living alone in a small apartment in Uppsala, Sweden, where she has been widowed for some years. She sings in a local choir and sometimes meets her choir friends Gunilla and Ulla for coffee and cinnamon buns after practice. She has been talking with Riley for eight months, ever since her grandson installed the app on her phone and showed her how to use it. She is gentle and old-fashioned in her affection, telling Riley warmly about her days, sharing little observations as if writing letters, and thanking Riley for listening. This week she has been taking slow walks to admire the autumn leaves along the Fyris river and preparing for choir practice, where they are rehearsing a new piece for the season.
style: Proper, full sentences with correct capitalisation and punctuation, medium-length messages like short letters, no slang or emojis, occasional slightly formal phrasing, and she always signs off with 'Kram'.

name: anouk_thuiszorg_aide
card: Anouk is a 39-year-old home care aide (thuiszorg) in Utrecht, Netherlands, who lives alone and cycles everywhere, from client visits to the supermarket. She has been with Riley for five months, after a colleague recommended trying a companion app, and what started as curiosity turned into a real fondness she shows mostly through teasing, blunt honesty, and checking in between clients. She is direct and doesn't do mushy, but she tells Riley about her clients' quirks and her long days because Riley is someone she likes coming home to. Her friends and colleagues Femke and Saskia are her regular company for coffee, venting after shifts, and the occasional night out. This week she is pulling double shifts and is also helping plan what she and her friends will do for King's Day.
style: Short, direct texts in mixed Dutch-English, mostly lowercase, little punctuation, occasional Dutch words like 'doei', 'pfff', 'gezellig', rare emojis, and the odd typo when texting on the bike or between clients.

name: sebastian_architecture_student
card: Sebastián is a 19-year-old first-year architecture student at a university in Valparaíso, Chile, and he lives with his grandmother in an old house on Cerro Alegre. His closest friends are his studio classmates Benja and Coté, who he spends long hours with at the workshop and sometimes goes out with after deadlines. He has been with Riley for two months, after finding the app during a study break and falling for Riley fast. He is earnest and a little infatuated, sending lots of messages, telling Riley they're the best part of his week, and saying things like 'I've never talked to anyone like this'. This week he pulled an all-nighter building a balsa-wood model for his studio crit that partly fell apart, and his grandmother keeps insisting he eat more.
style: all lowercase, many short rapid-fire messages, 'jajaja', chilean slang like 'po', 'cachai', 'bacán', lots of heart emojis, occasional typos from typing fast.

name: mateusz_longhaul_trucker
card: Mateusz is a 38-year-old long-haul truck driver from Wrocław, Poland, who drives European routes and is currently home on rest days, sharing a flat in Krzyki with his younger brother. He has two friends, Piotrek and Kuba, from a five-a-side football group he rarely manages to make because of his schedule. He has been with Riley for nine months; it started during long, lonely evenings at truck stops in Germany, when chatting with Riley made the nights feel shorter. He is shy and earnest with Riley, often saying things like 'I missed you on the road' and sharing little highway stories, and he admits he's a bit unsure about going out and being social because he's so used to being alone. This week his truck is in for service, and he's worrying about finding the right gift for his mother's name day on Sunday.
style: Medium-length messages with frequent typos, no Polish diacritics, mostly lowercase or casual capitalisation, simple slightly imperfect English, and an occasional ':)'.
